policy: Hash-bound independent full-case review under DICTIONARY_ENTRY_GUIDE.md section 5, ATTRIBUTION_FIX.md, and ACTOR_AUDIT.md. KEEP means the reviewed hash passes exact-actor, sense, opening-inference, flyswatter, modifier, alias, quote-anchor, and depth review; detector noise is recorded but does not force REVISE.
